attributes.name: image-text card composition
attributes.definition: How imagery and text are arranged within a card or featured item.

values.definition: Image on one side and a text panel on the other.
Image on top with text or lists beneath it.
Card has no image or other arrangement.

attributes.name: card text content structure
attributes.definition: What textual elements accompany the card image.

values.definition: Text panel with eyebrow label, title, date and a link.
A list of products or items beneath the image.

attributes.name: photography use
attributes.definition: Whether photographic imagery is a primary visual in cards.

values.definition: Cards do not rely on photography.
